newsitem.title: INDIA: India Asian Paints jumps on ICI news.
newsitem.headline: India Asian Paints jumps on ICI news.

text.p: Shares of Asian Paints India Ltd jumped on Monday on news the British chemicals and paints group ICI Plc had purchased a 9.1 percent stake, traders said.
At 0915 GMT, Asian Paints shares were 24.30 rupees, or 7.4 percent, higher at 353.80 at the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
ICI Plc said in London that it had purchased a 9.1 percent stake in Asian Paints for 23 million sterling.
A Bombay-based finance firm Kotak Mahindra Capital Company said it had purchased the shares from the Choksey family, one of four original promoters of Asian Paints.
"Thereafter, Kotak Mahindra Capital Company has agreed to sell these shares to ICI Plc at 351 rupees per share subject to approvals," it said in a statement.
Asian Paints shares closed at 311.75 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange last week. The bourse was closed on Monday for a local holiday.
